core_obligations: The construction (proof lines 662-690): for an abelian group a functorial embedding into an injective group is chosen, and for a sheaf of abelian groups the author forms the sheaf whose value on an open set is the product over the points of the set of the chosen injective groups at the stalks, with the canonical map given by the embeddings of the germs.

Injectivity of the map and of the target (proof lines 690-699): the canonical map is injective on stalks and hence injective, and the constructed sheaf is a product of skyscraper sheaves at the points, which are injective, so the product is injective by the cited lemma; both the construction and the map are functorial.
proof_roadmap: Choose functorial injective embeddings of the groups and form the product of the corresponding skyscraper sheaves.
Check that the canonical map from a sheaf into it is injective on stalks.
Use the product rule for injectives to conclude, and note functoriality.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of abelian sheaves on a topological space has enough injectives and in fact functorial injective embeddings (statement lines 655-660). The proof is a complete construction: for an abelian group a functorial embedding into an injective group is chosen, and a sheaf is mapped into the sheaf whose sections are the products over the points of the chosen injective groups at the stalks, which is a product of skyscraper sheaves (proof lines 662-690); the map is injective because it is injective on stalks, and the target is injective because products of injective objects are injective, so the assignment is a functorial injective embedding (proof lines 690-699). The non-formal content is the skyscraper construction and the injectivity check. The claim is H2.
